app.name: HuskyNote
app.tagline: A local-first AI secretary for meetings, documents, and notes.

dashboard.subtitle: Everything is saved privately on your device. Fast, offline, and secure.
dashboard.welcomeBanner: Welcome back. All recordings, documents, and notes are saved on your device.

welcome.title: Welcome to HuskyNote
welcome.body: A quick look around: notes, meetings, voice typing, and AI that works with your own workspace. Everything is saved on this device. Use the arrow keys or the buttons below; Esc ends the tour.

navigation.title: Everything in one sidebar
navigation.body: Move between your dashboard, notes, meetings, documents, the AI Workspace and more. Ctrl+B hides the sidebar when you want more room.

profiles.title: Profiles keep work apart
profiles.body: Each profile is its own workspace with separate notes, meetings and settings, such as Work and Personal. Switch profiles or create one here.

search.title: Find anything fast
search.body: Search your notes, meetings and documents. Press Ctrl+K for commands, like starting a meeting or opening a setting.

voiceType.title: Voice Type
voiceType.body: Dictate from any screen. Click the mic and speak: the words go straight into the note you're editing, and you can copy the whole dictation when you stop.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Start a new note here. Your notes are listed next to the editor.

resizableLists.title: Resize or hide lists
resizableLists.body: Drag the edge of a list to make it wider or narrower, or collapse it to give the editor the whole screen. HuskyNote remembers your choice.

teamsImport.title: Bring in Teams meetings
teamsImport.body: Import a Teams transcript (.vtt or .docx) to keep its speaker names, or a recording to transcribe on this computer.

recording.title: Record a meeting
recording.body: Choose your microphone or a meeting tab as the audio source, then start recording. HuskyNote transcribes as you go, on this device.

aiWorkspace.title: AI Workspace
aiWorkspace.body: Ask questions about your notes, meetings and documents. Attach the items you want the AI to use as context.

aiProviders.title: Choose your AI
aiProviders.body: Run AI locally with Ollama, use a Claude API key, or sign in with your Claude or ChatGPT plan. Pick one here; you can change it any time.

transcription.title: Set up transcription
transcription.body: Pick your usual conversation language and download a speech model once. After that, speech is turned into text on this device.

finish.title: That's the tour
finish.body: To see it again, open Help & about at the bottom of the sidebar and choose Take me for a tour, or press Ctrl+K and search for "tour".
